sql.sql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "messages_fts" USING fts5(body, content = 'messages', content_rowid = 'local_rowid', tokenize = 'unicode61 remove_diacritics 2 categories ''L* N* Co M*''');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "conversations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "avatar" BLOB NULL, "pinned_at" INTEGER NULL, "muted_until" INTEGER NULL, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), "last_message_rowid" INTEGER NULL, "last_message_sort_key" TEXT NULL, "last_message_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_message_preview" TEXT NULL, "unread_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "mention_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_read_sort_key" TEXT NULL, "draft" TEXT NULL, "disappearing_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "messages" ("local_rowid" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "message_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "conversation_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES conversations (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "sender" TEXT NOT NULL, "sender_device" TEXT NULL, "outgoing" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("outgoing" IN (0, 1)), "sort_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "sent_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "received_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "body" TEXT NULL, "payload" TEXT NULL, "reply_to_id" TEXT NULL, "reply_to_author" TEXT NULL, "forwarded" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("forwarded" IN (0, 1)), "mentions_me" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("mentions_me" IN (0, 1)), "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "edited_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "expire_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "expires_at" INTEGER NULL, "view_once_state" TEXT NULL, UNIQUE ("message_id", "sender"), UNIQUE ("conversation_id", "sort_key"));
CREATE TRIGGER messages_fts_insert AFTER INSERT ON messages BEGIN INSERT INTO messages_fts ("rowid", body) VALUES (new.local_rowid, new.body);END
CREATE TRIGGER messages_fts_delete AFTER DELETE ON messages BEGIN INSERT INTO messages_fts (messages_fts, "rowid", body) VALUES ('delete', old.local_rowid, old.body);END

CREATE TRIGGER messages_fts_update AFTER UPDATE OF body ON messages BEGIN INSERT INTO messages_fts (messages_fts, "rowid", body) VALUES ('delete', old.local_rowid, old.body);INSERT INTO messages_fts ("rowid", body) VALUES (new.local_rowid, new.body);END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "message_reactions" ("message_rowid" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES messages (local_rowid) ON DELETE CASCADE, "reactor" TEXT NOT NULL, "emoji" TEXT NOT NULL, "reacted_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("message_rowid", "reactor"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "message_receipts" ("message_rowid" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES messages (local_rowid) ON DELETE CASCADE, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "delivered_at" INTEGER NULL, "read_at" INTEGER NULL, "viewed_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("message_rowid", "account_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attachments" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "message_rowid" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES messages (local_rowid) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "media_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "media_key" BLOB NOT NULL, "digest" BLOB NOT NULL, "mime" TEXT NOT NULL, "size" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NULL, "width" INTEGER NULL, "height" INTEGER NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NULL, "waveform" BLOB NULL, "blurhash" TEXT NULL, "caption" TEXT NULL, "thumbnail" TEXT NULL, "thumbnail_path" TEXT NULL, "local_path" TEXT NULL, "transfer" TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("message_rowid", "position"));
CREATE INDEX messages_unread ON messages (conversation_id, status)
CREATE INDEX messages_message_id ON messages (message_id)
CREATE INDEX messages_expires_at ON messages (expires_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "conversation_members" ("conversation_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES conversations (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "joined_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("conversation_id", "account_id"));
CREATE INDEX conversations_list ON conversations (archived, last_message_at)
CREATE INDEX conversation_members_account ON conversation_members (account_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "self_account" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_domain" TEXT NOT NULL, "helix_name" TEXT NULL, "phone_number" TEXT NULL, "profile_name" TEXT NULL, "profile_key" BLOB NULL, "profile_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "registered_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (id = 1));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "self_devices" ("device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NULL, "platform" TEXT NULL, "linked_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_active_at" INTEGER NULL, "is_this_device" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_this_device" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("device_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "people" ("account_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "helix_name" TEXT NULL, "phone_number" TEXT NULL, "phone_hash" TEXT NULL, "phonebook_name" TEXT NULL, "nickname" TEXT NULL, "profile_name" TEXT NULL, "profile_key" BLOB NULL, "profile_version" INTEGER NULL, "avatar_blob" BLOB NULL, "identity_key" BLOB NULL, "identity_verified" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("identity_verified" IN (0, 1)), "identity_changed_at" INTEGER NULL, "blocked" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("blocked" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("account_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "person_devices" ("account_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "identity_key" BLOB NOT NULL, "signing_key" BLOB NOT NULL, "certificate" BLOB NULL, "trust" TEXT NOT NULL, "first_seen_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("account_id", "device_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "identity" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "aik_public" BLOB NOT NULL, "aik_private" BLOB NOT NULL, "dik_public" BLOB NOT NULL, "dik_private" BLOB NOT NULL, "dsk_public" BLOB NOT NULL, "dsk_private" BLOB NOT NULL, "device_certificate" BLOB NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (id = 1));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sessions" ("peer_account_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "peer_device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "slot" INTEGER NOT NULL, "state" BLOB NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("peer_account_id", "peer_device_id", "slot"), CHECK (slot BETWEEN 0 AND 5));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "prekeys" ("kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "key_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "public_key" BLOB NOT NULL, "private_key" BLOB NOT NULL, "signature" BLOB NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "retired_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("kind", "key_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sender_keys" ("group_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "dist_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" BLOB NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("group_id", "account_id", "device_id", "dist_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "inbox_cursor" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_processed_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_acked_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (id = 1));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "processed_envelopes" ("envelope_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sender_device" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "seq" INTEGER NULL, "outcome" TEXT NOT NULL, "processed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("envelope_id", "sender_device"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outbox_ops" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "conversation_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES conversations (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "message_rowid" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES messages (local_rowid) ON DELETE CASCADE, "idempotency_key" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "next_attempt_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "lease_until" INTEGER NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "deferred_actions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "target_message_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_author" TEXT NOT NULL, "sender" TEXT NOT NULL, "sender_device" TEXT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "received_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "expires_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE INDEX people_phone_hash ON people (phone_hash)
CREATE INDEX processed_envelopes_at ON processed_envelopes (processed_at)
CREATE INDEX outbox_ops_due ON outbox_ops (state, next_attempt_at)
CREATE INDEX deferred_actions_target ON deferred_actions (target_message_id, target_author)
CREATE INDEX deferred_actions_expiry ON deferred_actions (expires_at)
